Round173C.spectralBlock_cutoff_decomposition.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]

    spectralBlock s (fun i => η i - U.starProjection (η i)) v

Round175C.finite_jet_normalization_cost.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
  {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → E →L[ℂ] ℂ) (u : ι → E) (a : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
  (hinv : IsUnit (jetMatrix δ u).det) :
  (∀ (i j : ι), (δ i) (normalizedJetVector δ u j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ (x : E), (normalizedSpectralBlock δ u a) x = ∑ i, ∑ j, (a i j * (δ j) x) • normalizedJetVector δ u i) ∧
      0 ≤ blockRepresentationCost δ u a ∧ blockRepresentationCost δ u a ≤ inverseMatrixBlockCost δ u a
